Class GameResult

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.game.GameResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameResult extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable value object representing a single player's outcome in a completed game.

Instances of this class serve two purposes:

  • Persistence: written to and read from the MySQL game_results table via LeaderboardRepository.
  • Network transport: included in LeaderboardDelta and forwarded to clients at game end. The JsonCreator annotation supports Jackson deserialisation over Socket connections; Serializable supports native Java serialisation over RMI.

  • Constructor Details

    • GameResult

      public GameResult(String gameId, String playerNickname, int finalScore, int numPlayers, LocalDateTime gameDate)
      Constructs a GameResult. The JsonCreator annotation enables Jackson to deserialise instances when they are received over a Socket connection.
      Parameters:
      gameId - the unique identifier of the game (e.g. "GAME-1")
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player this result refers to
      finalScore - the player's prestige-point total at game end
      numPlayers - the number of players who participated in the game
      gameDate - the timestamp at which the game ended
